gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.259847 34.941178)',4326)::geography, 4200)
  AND p.amenity = 'restaurant'
  AND elev.z >= 220;

WITH papa_johns AS (

    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.259847 34.941178)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Buffer(geom, 4200) AS geom
  FROM papa_johns
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, 1, ST_Transform(geom, 4326)) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us, buffered_area
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(geom, 4326))
),
elevation_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_SummaryStats(clipped_rast, true)).*
  FROM dem_clip
  WHERE (ST_SummaryStats(clipped_rast, true)).mean >= 220
)
SELECT 
  'Restaurant within 4200 meters from Papa John''s, Greer, SC with elevation at least 220 m' AS description,
  (SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE ST_DWithin(ST_Transform(geometry, 4326), (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area), 4200) AND amenity = 'restaurant') AS restaurant_name
FROM elevation_filter
LIMIT 1;
